audio.note: samples are interleaved channels as a flat vector

memory.note: peak_rss_* are PROCESS-WIDE and SAMPLED: they include the wasm witness generator and anything else the binary holds, and a spike shorter than the sample interval can be missed, so each value is a LOWER BOUND on the true peak. Figures assume an otherwise-idle machine; concurrent load on the same process would inflate them. RSS is resident pages, which the OS may reclaim under pressure - it is a measurement of this run, not a minimum spec.

notes: compressed_prove_ms EXCLUDES CompressedSNARK::setup (measured as compressed_setup_ms). Logs predating schema_version 2 reported setup+prove summed, so those numbers are not directly comparable.
